data.name: AlAhsan
data.gender_notes: AlAhsan is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'hasana', meaning 'to make good, to be excellent'. AlAhsan is an honorific title given to someone who embodies the best qualities of humanity according to Islamic teachings. The name AlAhsan carries the meaning “The Best, Most Excellent” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose AlAhsan usually hope their child will grow to embody the best, most excellent and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: AlAhsan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The Best, Most Excellent.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of AlAhsan total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: الأحسن
in_arabic.meaning: أفضل و أنسب الأسماء لله تعالى، الحسن الجميل
in_arabic.long_meaning: الأحسن هو من أسماء الله الحسنى، يعني الذي يوصف بالحسن والجمال في كل شيء، وهو الذي يحسن كل شيء ويجعله جميلًا، وهو اسم من أسماء الله التي وردت في القرآن الكريم، مثل قوله تعالى: «ولله الأسماء الحسنى فادعوه بها» (الأعراف: 180).

in_urdu.name: الاحسن
in_urdu.meaning: اللہ تعالیٰ کا بہترین نام، خوبصورت اور اچھا
in_urdu.long_meaning: الاحسن اللہ تعالیٰ کے خوبصورت ناموں میں سے ایک ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے کہ وہ جو سب کچھ خوبصورت اور اچھا بناتا ہے، اور یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے درمیان میں بہت استعمال ہوتا ہے، اور اس کا مطلب عربی جڑوں سے ماخوذ ہے۔

in_hindi.name: अलअहसन
in_hindi.meaning: ईश्वर का उत्तम नाम, सुंदर और अच्छा
in_hindi.long_meaning: अलअहसन ईश्वर के सुंदर नामों में से एक है, जिसका अर्थ है कि वह जो सब कुछ सुंदर और अच्छा बनाता है, और यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में बहुत प्रयोग किया जाता है, और इसका अर्थ अरबी जड़ों से लिया गया है।

in_english.name: AlAhsan
in_english.meaning: The best name of Allah, beautiful and good
in_english.long_meaning: AlAhsan is one of the beautiful names of Allah, meaning 'the one who makes everything good and beautiful'. It is derived from the Arabic root 'A-H-S-N', which conveys the sense of goodness and beauty. This name is mentioned in the Quran, emphasizing the importance of calling upon Allah with His most beautiful names.

data.cultural_impact: AlAhsan holds a significant cultural impact in traditional Islamic communities as it symbolizes the purest of human virtues and is an ode to those who strive to lead a morally upstanding life. It's a title given to inspire and uplift individuals to be better versions of themselves, contributing positively to their communities, and society as a whole.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name AlAhsan lies in its association with the values of 'Ihsan', one of the 'Four Rightseous Caliphs' in Islamic theology. This concept of Ihsan is defined as perfect emulation of God in worship and morality, striving to maintain a pure heart and the righteous path. Thus, AlAhsan signifies a constant reminder of striving towards this ideal, a goal that is considered essential for spiritual growth and salvation within the Islamic tradition.
